english:
Performing a Finisher on an enemy of the <link Elite Tier or higher [#CombatantClassifications] /> restores 70 HP.

The Finisher also spawns 3 Loyal Void Moths that each grant a 22.5 HP <void Void Overshield /> to you and allies on impact.
